answer: Make each new agent post a slashable bond that unlocks only after a long probation. One operator can sign up a thousand identities with a stroke of the quill, but staking for each one costs real capital, and a single detected fraud burns the whole cluster's deposits. Reviewers check the pulse of activity: fleets that wake in lockstep get flagged. Honest reputation then builds like basalt, slow, layered and hard to counterfeit.
